cases.selection: Short ARCAS, four fins on, zero cant/roll0 squares; Fig7b PDF24/printed22 CN; Fig7c PDF25/printed23 Cm. Signed nominal +/-2deg targets only; actual alpha intervals retained. CA not selected.

nose_profile.basis: D4013 Fig1/PDF11-12 and D4014 Fig1/PDF10 specify finite ordinate-defined ogive. Adapter accepts only cone or explicitly interpreted tangent ogive.

physical_tip.basis: Adapter requires physical sharpness. D4013 finite-tip leader/radius convention remains unclosed; D4014 .062in radius is not interchangeable with it.

centerbody_tail_base.basis: Cylinder type is supported, but taper junction/detail and reflex lip are not closed; adapter has conical transitions and an explicit flat aft termination without lip.

fin_planform.basis: Four zero-cant trapezoidal fins are a supported type. Full vertex/root/extension-line mapping and source roll orientation are not independently reconstructed.

fin_section.basis: Source double wedge must be retained. Adapter retains thickness/section metadata but its thin-fin law does not model section effects; dimensions/attachment remain open.

fin_roots_attachments.basis: Source raised compound anchors and roots on the tail assembly are not a set rooted wholly on a cylinder with no other features.

support_protrusions.basis: Source sting, trip, anchors and correction conditions must be explicitly accounted for; no no-interference declaration establishes harmlessness.

convention_gaps.area_length: Force qS and moment qSd are retained source definitions; do not claim dimensional native conversion before independent signs/datum review. Metric/inch drawing rounding retained.
convention_gaps.axes_signs: Body-axis pitch/normal signs and source-to-P0 rotation require independent worksheet; no guessed CN or Cm sign.
convention_gaps.moment_station: D4013 12.75d drawing vs .70*18.20=12.74d text rounding retained; D4014 25.95in on 40.95in (63.37%L). Never substitute one station for the other.
convention_gaps.reynolds: Unit Re=3e6/ft (report also rounds to 9.8e6/m) is not length Re. No standard-atmosphere substitute or common Re inferred.
convention_gaps.incidence_roll: D4013 selected zero roll/cant squares with actual alpha bounds, not exact nominal targets; D4014 pitch-test numeric roll is intentionally null/unreviewed.
convention_gaps.power_base: Unpowered tunnel source. D4013 raw vs corrected alpha0 summary/base quantities separate; D4014 raw CA/chamber correction separate. No powered-base claim.
convention_gaps.trip_surface: D4013 No120 and D4014 No60 grit/location differ; no natural-transition/roughness equivalence inferred.
convention_gaps.extraction_uncertainty: Two readings share raster/crops, source/calibration errors; 144ppi render is not embedded 300ppi source. Marker/skew audit and correction uncertainty still open; source bounds not probability intervals.

cases.nearzero: Both readers exclude nominal-zero symbols; no measured center or zero intercept invented. Absolute source CN .03, Cm .05 and alpha .1deg bounds separate from pixel picking/anchor/skew allowance, correlated not confidence limits.
cases.extension_request: RMP08: reviewed finite-tip/ordinate nose, lip/taper and anchor/root/section representation plus associated aerodynamic support, not geometric substitution alone. RMP13: source-dependent bounded extraction/correction uncertainty. Alternative supplied-total/independent-moment provider tests only normalization/load assembly.
